ctx.x: With George Wein Williams and at the New Repertory York Jazz Repertoire Company, and it was a great sucess, and so it was repeated again in Nice. But that was the only time I had ever had a band of my own over there.
Uh huh. What countries did you seem to like best over there and what countries did you seem to like the jazz music best?
